$description: Machine-readable checkpoint for agent session state. Companion to current-session.md (human ledger). Write at blocking boundaries only.

task_id.description: Active task bundle ID, or null if no task in progress

status.description: active=working, blocked=waiting for external input, handed_off=passed to another agent, completed=session done

last_completed_step.description: ID or short description of last completed step

next_step.description: What the resuming agent should do next

blocked_reason.description: Why execution stopped. null if not blocked

steps_completed.description: Number of steps completed so far

read_set.description: Files/docs this session has read or needs to read

write_scope.description: Paths this session is authorized to write

verification_target.description: How to verify the work is correct

resume_context.description: One-paragraph context for an agent resuming from this checkpoint. Must be self-contained — no reference to chat history.

handoff.description: Non-null when handing off to another agent
handoff.handoff_artifact: string — path to handoff packet or bundle
